run.question: List the top 5 largest Elasticsearch indices matching the pattern 'app-184-*' by document count. Show their names and doc counts.

report.summary: Querying the registered Elasticsearch source for indices matching 'app-184-*' returned 1800 matching indices. Sorted by docs.count descending, the five largest indices all hold 500 documents each and are followed by indices holding 1 document, so the 500-document group is exactly these five. This is a read-only index-inventory question; no service health or incident conclusion is drawn.
